label: practices law in place
definition: Person X is explicitly described as a lawyer practicing or professionally based in geographic place Y.
scope_notes: Includes: explicit lawyer-in place; a city or geographic nominal modifier of a lawyer establishing professional location; historical legal practice in the place. Excludes: representing a client or institution alone; a law firm or personal client in the geographic argument slot; residence or travel alone without legal practice. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: public attorney office for a jurisdiction without evidence of practice location; geographic versus institutional meaning of Y unresolved; unclear attachment of the place to the lawyer. Separate from lawyer_for, which concerns representation or professional institutional affiliation. A governmental jurisdiction as client or office does not automatically establish this geographic practice predicate.
